name: RECOVERY_AUTHORITY
cause_chain: no adjudicated authority for recovery decisions
wal.lisp resolves PREPARED by assumption at recovery start
wal_triad_bridge.py refuses to resolve IN_DOUBT without an explicit frame
impact_chain: CON-INV-07 cannot be satisfied while both surfaces exist
recovery outcome depends on which surface runs
replay and canonical effect can diverge after a crash
dependency_chain: then re-run the crash-recovery test against the adopted rule

name: WAL_TAIL_POLICY
cause_chain: storage norm for partial tail records never adopted
implementation asserts truncation as the recovery operation
impact_chain: any append-only claim that depends on the tail is unclassifiable
test corpus encodes the unadopted decision
dependency_chain: then decide whether the existing test is a violation or a specification of the norm

name: DURABILITY_NORM
cause_chain: durability definition left open in the design
code#01 defines it as fdatasync success
code asserts precedence via its local tx table without a Canonical History comparison path
impact_chain: durability claim is implementation-defined, not adopted
linearization-point claim is VERIFIED only under the unadopted definition
dependency_chain: then build the Canonical History join path for precedence semantics

name: SURFACE_DIVERGENCE
cause_chain: two independent implementation surfaces for the same state semantics
impact_chain: no VERIFIED status can be assigned to the divergent nodes until authority is fixed
dependency_chain: adjudication must precede any classification change
